interpretation_scope: Exploratory fixed-rule comparison on all 2112 already examined local test images; no retuning from test results, no validation-selected optimum, no default replacement

semantics.prediction_area: independent COCO RLE; no bbox passed to loadRes

results.method: 整图优先＋跨视图一致性
整图优先＋截断处理＋一致性
整图优先＋仅补充小目标切片候选

variant_descriptions.global_guard: 优先保留分数≥0.5、预测面积>1024的整图候选，再进行原跨视图掩码去重
variant_descriptions.global_guard_edge: 保护整图＋降低内部裁剪边缘候选优先级，剔除被可靠整图掩码包含的疑似截断候选
variant_descriptions.global_guard_consensus: 保护整图＋按其他高置信度视图的掩码一致性调整选择优先级
variant_descriptions.global_guard_edge_consensus: 保护整图＋裁剪边缘处理＋跨视图一致性
variant_descriptions.small_tiles_only: 保护整图，且切片仅提供预测面积≤1024的小目标候选

instance_capacity.scope: Post-hoc count-only diagnostic; no inference rule changes

material_passport.limitations: Exploratory examined-test comparison; no statistical significance, speed or validation-optimal claim
